quests.name: FIXTURE Envelope Quest A
quests.description: Imports cleanly. Its scene pin (scene 1, pin 1) must be placed.
quests.plotHook: The party is asked to recover the Wayfinder casing.

quests.description: THE FAILING ENTRY. Its `name` is empty, which is the one condition our importer rejects outright (`if (!quest.name) continue;`, panel-quest.js). Nothing is created for it, so the scene-2 pin below references a quest that will not exist. That pin must surface as a warning in the result envelope, not a console line.

quests.name: FIXTURE Envelope Quest C
quests.description: Imports cleanly. Carries an OBJECTIVE pin (scene 1, pin 2) as well as a quest pin, so both pin kinds are exercised.
quests.plotHook: A rumour about the Black Fist.

questPins._fixtureNote: questIndex and questCategory are INFERRED from the Pins API config object, not observed in the legacy scene flag. Nothing has written that flag since the Pins API migration (TODO C4), so its true historical shape is unknowable. Stable core is questUuid, x, y, objectiveIndex.
ORPHANED BY DESIGN. Points at the empty-name quest above, which is never created. This is the case the design is for: the pin cannot be placed and the reason must reach the result envelope.

ORPHANED BY DESIGN, second flavour. References a quest that is not in this payload at all — a stale pin from a partial export — rather than one that failed. Both should warn; whether they warn identically is your call.
